# Avatar (`avatar`)

Photo or initials in sizes, supporter ring, stacked groups.

Group: Data display. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/data-display';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createAvatar` (types in `dist/web/data-display/avatar.d.ts`): `.mh-avatar`: initials on a series colour, or an image (`__image` over `__initials`), in sizes `--sm | --lg | --xl`, with an optional `__status` dot. `role="img"` named by `name`.

```ts
export function createAvatar(options: AvatarOptions): AvatarHandle;

export interface AvatarOptions {
  /** Accessible name; initials are taken from it. */
  name: string;
  /** Image URL; initials show while it loads and if it fails. */
  src?: string;
  size?: AvatarSize;
  status?: AvatarStatus;
  /** Override the initials ("LR"). */
  initials?: string;
}

export interface AvatarHandle {
  el: HTMLSpanElement;
  setStatus(status: AvatarStatus | null): void;
}
```

`createAvatarGroup` (types in `dist/web/data-display/avatar.d.ts`): `.mh-avatar-group`: overlapping avatars with a "+N" for the rest.

```ts
export function createAvatarGroup(options: AvatarGroupOptions):;

export interface AvatarGroupOptions {
  avatars: AvatarOptions[];
  /** Show at most this many; the rest become "+N". */
  max?: number;
  size?: AvatarSize;
  label?: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createAvatar, createAvatarGroup } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const owner = createAvatar({ name: 'Ada Brook', size: 'large', status: 'online' });

const people = createAvatarGroup({
  label: 'People at home',
  max: 3,
  avatars: [{ name: 'Ada Brook' }, { name: 'Tomas Reed' }, { name: 'Lena Ortiz' }, { name: 'Sam Hale' }],
});

// Status follows presence, for example when the person leaves home.
setTimeout(() => owner.setStatus('away'), 3000);

document.body.append(owner.el, people.el);
```
